title: TranscriptExtractorMinimalOutput
description: Wave 26 Pass L (2026-05-27) — Minimal 8-field schema for the transcript_extractor role. Flat structure (no $ref nesting) to avoid the recursive-loop bug gemma4:e2b hits with the v11 schema. Passed as `format` object to Ollama /api/chat for GBNF grammar-constrained sampling.

strategies.description: Strategies the extractor was able to capture. Empty array is honest — don't invent.

name.description: snake_case name combining speaker's pattern + timeframes. null lets pipeline derive.

lower_timeframe.description: Chart used for entry trigger. null if same as higher.

direction.description: DEFAULT='both'. Use 'long' or 'short' ONLY when the speaker explicitly says 'only longs' / 'only shorts' / 'I never short' / 'this is a long-only setup'. If your entry_sequence steps contain ANY of: 'or short', 'or low', 'opposite end', 'mirror', 'for short entry', 'puts' alongside 'calls' → direction MUST be 'both'. Chart-mechanic strategies (VWAP, EMA, breakout, structure) default to 'both'. NEVER pick 'long' just because the speaker's example was long — the speaker showing one example does NOT mean the strategy is one-direction.

entry_sequence.description: Ordered steps the speaker teaches to enter the trade. 1 step for simple strategies; multiple for phased setups (accumulation → manipulation → breakout → rebalance → entry). DO NOT invent steps to look thorough — 1-step output is honest when the speaker is simple.

action.description: The action at this step, in speaker's words when possible.

rationale.description: Why this step matters — speaker quote if available, null when implicit.

preferred_regime.description: trending | ranging | any | speaker's specific term

stop.description: Initial stop placement. anchor=null falls back to framework default (1.5x ATR + structural ceiling).

anchor.description: Where the initial stop sits. NEVER fixed_points (banned per CLAUDE.md §13).

buffer_atr.description: Extra cushion in ATR units beyond the anchor.

stop_management.description: 1 sentence rule for moving the stop AFTER entry. null if speaker doesn't specify.

targets.description: What the speaker is aiming at. Empty array if speaker doesn't say (framework Style C 33/33/33 default kicks in).

type.description: Canonical type or speaker's own term (snake_case).

r_multiple.description: R-multiple if speaker stated one (e.g. 1.5 for 'minimum 1.5R').

confluences.description: THE KEY FIELD — every condition the speaker says must be TRUE before they take a trade. Empty array is honest.

name.description: Speaker's term (if named) or descriptive snake_case label.

canonical_match.description: Map to one of the 11 canonical factors if it fits, else null.

rejected_strategies.description: Strategies the extractor found but couldn't use. Helps downstream observability.
